body: prime_directive_dataset.py: --game-replays <dir> and --max-game-records flags added; load_game_replays() reads *.ndjson replay files and converts {state,action} to instruction pairs {prompt,completion}. build_game_corpus.py: standalone aggregator that reads replay dir, deduplicates, writes JSONL. Smoke test: 5 synthetic records → 5 output records.
title: S39-03: --game-replays flag in dataset builder + build_game_corpus.py
